expectation: Maintain an exact dependency inventory tied to the reviewed commit and artifacts.
completion_criteria: Every Inventory row has Review status = Reviewed.

expectation: Consume npm dependencies only through CFS or an approved Azure Artifacts feed.
completion_criteria: Zero npm rows have CFS admission = Unavailable or Exact version unavailable.
authority: Central Feed Services / Third Party Software Governance

expectation: Do not ship a dependency with an unresolved Critical technical-risk finding.
completion_criteria: Zero Inventory rows have Technical risk = Critical.

expectation: Resolve missing technical, legal, procurement, and immutable-artifact evidence.
completion_criteria: Zero Inventory rows have Technical risk = Unknown.
authority: Third Party Software Governance and release provenance

expectation: Record an authoritative remediation, exception, or owner decision for every High-risk dependency.
completion_criteria: Zero High-risk rows remain Microsoft disposition = Review required.
authority: Security owner and governing exception process

expectation: Replace conservative Review required dispositions with governed-control evidence or an explicit exception.
completion_criteria: Zero Inventory rows remain Microsoft disposition = Review required.
authority: CFS, Component Governance, and applicable exception authority

expectation: Ensure Component Governance detects the exact OpenClaw lock/SBOM and built-image dependency inventory.
current_evidence: The current Lobster source scan does not detect most installed OpenClaw transitives or the built image. Experimental run 176596891 parsed a staged OpenClaw 2026.8.1 lock while Lobster installed 2026.5.28, so it is not valid product control evidence; PR #8174 was closed.
completion_criteria: A successful governed run records the reviewed commit and detects the reconciled exact dependency manifest with no unexplained omissions.

expectation: Make blocking Component Governance alerts fail the governed build.
current_evidence: Lobster Official.Build.yml currently sets cg.failOnAlert: false.
completion_criteria: The governed build enables blocking alerts and succeeds with no unresolved blocking alert.

expectation: Resolve authoritative security alerts before attestation.
current_evidence: Analysis artifact commit 0d39d1f86a8 replaces js-yaml@4.3.0 with 4.3.1. PR #123513 was closed when the work returned to analysis-only scope; the control remains open until a separately authorized governed release detects the exact installed manifest and closes the alert.
completion_criteria: The governed manifest no longer contains js-yaml@4.3.0 and the blocking alert is closed.

expectation: Resolve missing or unacceptable license evidence.
current_evidence: Analysis artifact commit 0d39d1f86a8 updates werift to 0.24.3 and removes rx.mini from the lock. PR #123513 was closed when the work returned to analysis-only scope; the control remains open until a separately authorized governed release confirms the exact installed manifest excludes rx.mini.
completion_criteria: The exact manifest excludes rx.mini or contains authoritative legal evidence permitting the intended use.

expectation: Establish procurement/GovID/SSPA evidence for third-party hosted services and actions.
current_evidence: Four Blacksmith Testbox action SHAs have internal usage precedent but no located procurement or exception record.
completion_criteria: A durable procurement, GovID, SSPA, or approved exception record covers the exact service usage.

expectation: Use immutable exact image identities in promotion and release evidence.
current_evidence: Analysis artifact commit 39b18ffbe4f pins the live-media runner's Ubuntu base to the repository's existing immutable digest. PR #123513 was closed when the work returned to analysis-only scope. The Cloudflare declaration still contains a promoted-image digest placeholder, and governed image evidence has not confirmed released digests.
completion_criteria: Every external shipped image reference resolves to the promoted immutable digest recorded by the governed build.
authority: Release provenance and artifact integrity policy

expectation: Publish a durable dependency-control attestation for the exact OpenClaw commit and released artifact.
current_evidence: No single governed record currently ties the reviewed commit, CFS resolution, reconciled CG manifest, alert enforcement, exceptions, and image digests together.
completion_criteria: A successful governed run records the commit, lock/SBOM digest, CG correlation and manifest, CFS result, exceptions, image digests, and release identifier.
depends_on: MS-CFS-01, MS-EVID-01, MS-HIGH-01, MS-DISP-01, MS-CG-02, MS-VULN-01, MS-LIC-01, MS-SVC-01, MS-IMG-01
